title: Brave browser profiles
whyItMatters: Brave keeps history, sessions, bookmarks and saved logins per profile, plus its own wallet and rewards state. The profiles show who used the browser and what they did.
source: Brave is Chromium-based and keeps the Chromium user data layout under ~/.config/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser: https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: Matches the Preferences marker file, so non-profile folders are skipped. Brave Beta and Nightly use Brave-Browser-Beta and Brave-Browser-Nightly sibling folders. The Flatpak keeps the tree under ~/.var/app/com.brave.Browser/config/BraveSoftware.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Brave, export your passwords from the password manager and your bookmarks from the bookmark manager, and save both files off this computer.
cleanup.signOut: In Brave, open Settings > Sync and leave the sync chain, so the account keeps the synced data and this computer drops out of it.
steps: Close every Brave window, including the window that keeps running in the tray.
Uninstall Brave from the App Center, or from the Snap or Flatpak tool if you installed it that way.
Move the profile folder that holds the file named in the plan to the Trash, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Brave profile on this computer: history, bookmarks, saved passwords, cookies, extensions and any Brave Wallet or Rewards data.
cleanup.source: Brave Help Center, Delete Sync Account FAQ: https://support.brave.app/hc/en-us/articles/12944495986957-Delete-Sync-Account-FAQ
